intro.title: Enrichment Zone
intro.subtitle: Extra learning for curious minds!
intro.description: Explore beyond the classroom with fun activities, videos, worksheets, and challenges. From puzzles to science experiments to reading adventures — there's something here for every curious learner.

items.title: Welcome to Enrichment
items.excerpt: A short introduction to what enrichment is all about — learning for the love of it.
items.body: Enrichment is all about learning new things just because they're interesting. In this video, we explore what makes enrichment special and how it can help you discover new passions.

items.title: 5 Fun Math Tricks
items.excerpt: Amaze your friends with these quick mental math tricks.
items.body: Learn 5 fun math tricks that will make you look like a math wizard. Perfect for showing off at family dinners!

items.title: Science Experiments You Can Do at Home
items.excerpt: Safe, simple science experiments using things you have at home.
items.body: Turn your kitchen into a science lab! These 3 experiments are safe, easy, and use ingredients you already have at home. Always ask a grown-up first!

items.title: How to Fall in Love with Reading
items.excerpt: Tips to make reading a daily habit you actually enjoy.
items.body: Not everyone loves reading at first — and that's okay! This video shares simple tips to help you find books you'll genuinely enjoy.

items.title: Grade 3 Math Enrichment
items.excerpt: Fun math puzzles and challenges for Grade 3.
items.body: A collection of math enrichment worksheets for Grade 3 — including number puzzles, pattern challenges, and shape games.

items.title: Grade 4 Math Enrichment
items.body: Take your math skills further with these Grade 4 enrichment worksheets — including logic puzzles, word problems, and geometry.

items.title: Grade 5 Science Discovery
items.body: Hands-on science activities for Grade 5 — from observing plants to testing simple machines. Perfect for curious minds.

items.title: Grade 6 Reading Challenge
items.excerpt: A reading challenge to expand your world.
items.body: A 10-book reading challenge with discussion questions and creative response prompts. Complete the challenge and earn a certificate!

items.title: Critical Thinking Puzzle Pack
items.excerpt: Brain teasers that make you think differently.
items.body: A pack of 20 brain teasers designed to sharpen your critical thinking. Includes riddles, logic puzzles, and pattern challenges.

items.title: Creative Writing Prompts
items.excerpt: 50 story starters to spark your imagination.
items.body: Never run out of ideas again! This pack has 50 creative writing prompts — from time travel to talking animals to unexpected adventures.

items.title: Drawing Challenge Cards
items.excerpt: 30 drawing challenges to unlock your creativity.
items.body: Draw a robot, a dream house, a monster with a friendly face — 30 challenges to keep you creating.

items.title: Khan Academy Kids
items.excerpt: Free learning games and lessons for kids.
items.body: Khan Academy Kids offers free, world-class learning in math, reading, and more — designed for young learners.

items.title: National Geographic Kids
items.excerpt: Explore the world through science and discovery.
items.body: Discover animals, science, and geography with National Geographic Kids — full of amazing facts, games, and videos.

items.title: NASA Kids' Club
items.excerpt: Learn about space, planets, and rockets.
items.body: Blast off with NASA's Kids' Club — interactive games, videos, and stories about space exploration.
